title: Assembly of compatible null-homotopies across a short exact sequence
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. Let $0\to Z^\bullet\xrightarrow{i} I^\bullet\xrightarrow{\pi} B^\bullet\to0$ be a degreewise short exact sequence of cochain complexes, augmented by a compatible short exact sequence $0\to Z_0\to I_0\to B_0\to0$ such that the three augmented complexes are exact. Let $0\to J_Z^\bullet\xrightarrow{j} J_I^\bullet\xrightarrow{\rho} J_B^\bullet\to0$ be a degreewise short exact sequence of injective resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions], with compatible augmentations. Suppose a morphism of complexes $R_I:I^\bullet\to J_I^\bullet$ induces maps $R_Z:Z^\bullet\to J_Z^\bullet$ and $R_B:B^\bullet\to J_B^\bullet$ with $R_Ii=jR_Z$ and $\rho R_I=R_B\pi$, satisfies $R_I\epsilon_I=0$, and suppose $s_Z$ is a null-homotopy of $R_Z$ with $s_Z^0\epsilon_Z=0$. Then there are maps $s_I^q:I^q\to J_I^{q-1}$ and $s_B^q:B^q\to J_B^{q-1}$, with $s_I^0=s_B^0=0$, such that $R_I=d s_I+s_I d$, $R_B=d s_B+s_Bd$, $s_Ii=js_Z$, and $\rho s_I=s_B\pi$.

source.place: Tag 015I, compatibility of the boundary/cycle exact sequences; Weibel Homological Algebra, Lemma 5.7.10

proof.text: Cancel the epic augmentation quotient S.g in the degree-zero compatibility square to show epsilonB.f 0 >> RB.f 0 = 0. Apply the already proved CochainComplex.homotopyZeroOfQuasiIso from WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Cohomology.DirectImage.CechResolution. This fully proved upstream construction directly gives sB, without using the general integer-indexed K-injective theorem recorded by lem-weil-pbc-acyclic-map-to-injective-nullhomotopy. Extend each relevant component of sZ across the monic i.f n using Injective.factorThru, putting zero in all degrees excluded by the homotopy shape. Split the target short exact sequence degreewise by injectivity of JZ, obtaining sections Q of rho. Set t(n,m) = a(n,m) >> j.f m + pi.f n >> sB.hom n m >> Q m. Composition and the two zero composites prove i t = sZ j and t rho = pi sB.

source.place: Tag 015I, comparison construction for the boundary and cycle rows; Weibel Homological Algebra, Lemma 5.7.10

proof.text: Use Homotopy.nullHomotopicMap t to construct F = dt + td as an actual chain map. Naturality of this construction and the given homotopy equations show i >> F = RZ >> j and F >> rho = pi >> RB. Put E = RI - F. Thus i >> E = 0 and E >> rho = 0. HomologicalComplex.shortExact_of_degreewise_shortExact makes the source and target rows short exact in the category of complexes. Descend E through pi and lift the result through j using ShortComplex.Exact.desc and ShortComplex.Exact.lift; this gives the unique chain map e with pi >> e >> j = E. At degree zero, epsilonI >> d = 0 and prevD 0 t = 0 imply epsilonI.f 0 >> E.f 0 = 0. Cancel S.g and j.f 0 to obtain epsilonB.f 0 >> e.f 0 = 0.

source.place: Tag 015I, compatibility of the boundary/cycle exact sequences

proof.text: Apply CochainComplex.homotopyZeroOfQuasiIso a second time, now to epsilonB and e, obtaining k : Homotopy e 0. Add the null-homotopy of F to (k.compLeft pi).compRight j. Since F + pi >> e >> j = RI, the resulting components define sI : Homotopy RI 0. Its components are t(n,m) + pi.f n >> k.hom n m >> j.f m. The zero composites pi i and rho j give both required compatibility identities.

source.place: Tag 015I, compatibility of the boundary/cycle exact sequences; Weibel Homological Algebra, Lemma 5.7.10

proof.text: The shape condition of a homotopy of natural-number cochain complexes implies sI.hom 0 m = 0 and sB.hom 0 m = 0, since there is no relation from m to 0. Return sI, sB, these normalizations and the two compatibility identities.
